description: Get public metadata about what data is available across all Sharpe Terminal products, including supported exchanges, coins, timeframes, and chart types.
name: get_api_coverage

datasets.description: The datasets behind the product with their writer cadence and freshness SLA: the numbers `freshness_sla` states in words.

cadence_seconds.description: Seconds between two runs of the dataset's writer; 0 when it is fetched per request.

freshness_sla_seconds.description: Seconds after its as_of past which the dataset's answers say `freshness_status: "stale"` (the writer's cadence plus one skipped run).

public_api_routes.description: Always empty since 2026-11-11: the API is paid-only and no keyless route is open to outside callers. Kept so clients that read the field keep working.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: API data coverage
